topics.description: Tax fraud is a growing concern, with several high-profile cases emerging in recent weeks. The issue is particularly significant in Minnesota, where a man has been accused of underreporting his income by nearly $2M. The trend is likely to continue, with more cases expected to come to light in the coming months.

Child care funding fraud is a significant issue, with billions of dollars in funding being misused or stolen. The introduction of the Stop Child Care Funding Fraud Act of 2026 is a major development in this area, and is likely to lead to increased scrutiny and regulation of child care funding.
